title: checkpoint helper (green-gated commit)
acceptance_criteria: Refuses on `main`; no-ops on a clean tree; requires a subject
Rollback path documented in the header (restore / reset)
goal: A helper that commits the current work as a checkpoint **only if the verification ladder passes** — checkpoint on green, never on red (doc 02).
notes: Rollback kept as documented git commands (destructive — prefer explicit over a script).
